title: Forge the Escape
prompt: Build the line that lets the Warden LEAVE the loop the moment he reaches the door.

fragments.wrong_hint: continue only skips to the next step — the Warden needs to LEAVE the loop. That is break.
Printing describes the door. It does not open it or free anyone.

config.success: if at_door: break — the one line the Warden's own loop was missing.
